items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Wemby had a career night, but the #Spurs needed some strong defense by De'Aaron Fox in the final seconds to pull out the win over the Mavs.

"D-Fox did a great job of bumping me off my spot,” Kyrie Irving said.
